disagreements_with_page.note: Page figure is from the pre-v4.2 index (v4.1.x, Aug 26 launch); the page itself flags that the 57 to 62 figures predate v4.2. Version difference, not an error, but the figures should not sit beside v4.3 values.

disagreements_with_page.page: 59, up 3 from 3.7 Flash; about $0.58 per Intelligence Index task
disagreements_with_page.aa_now: 40.9 vs 3.7 Flash 39.1 (up 1.9) on v4.3; $1.24 per task (3.7 Flash $0.93, so about +34%)
disagreements_with_page.note: Page figures match AA's 2026-09-02 article (pre-v4.2). The "about 40% more per task" claim is Google's; on v4.3 AA cost per task is about 34% higher.

disagreements_with_page.aa_now: GPT-5.6 Sol (max) 47.0, Grok 4.6 (high) 44.3, Gemini 3.8 Flash 40.9 on v4.3; no longer level
disagreements_with_page.note: Page figure is pre-v4.2. AA's Sep 2 Muse article actually put GPT-5.6 Sol (max) and Grok 4.6 (high) at 61, tied with Muse Spark 1.3 (xhigh), and Gemini 3.8 Flash at 59; GPT-5.6 Sol (xhigh) was the 59.

disagreements_with_page.page: 61 (xhigh) and 62 (max), "third among labs on the reranked v4.2 index"
disagreements_with_page.note: AA published 61/62 on 2026-09-02; AA announced v4.2 on 2026-09-04, so those figures are pre-v4.2, not v4.2. The page contradicts itself (later it says the 57 to 62 figures predate v4.2); the "v4.2" label is the wrong half.

disagreements_with_page.page: $0.55 per task, the cheapest model scoring 59 or above
disagreements_with_page.aa_now: $1.37 per Intelligence Index task on v4.3
disagreements_with_page.note: Pre-v4.2 cost figure; v4.3 adds Terminal-Bench 4.0 and AutomationBench-AA, which raise per-task cost across models.

disagreements_with_page.note: Not a conflict on values; AA's Sep 2 article said max-tier pricing was not public, so the page's chart_data attribution of the price to the max row was unsourced at the time.

disagreements_with_page.page: revised three times in September 2026 (v4.1, then v4.2 on 4 September, then v4.3)
disagreements_with_page.aa_now: v4.2 announced 2026-09-04; v4.3 announced 2026-09-07; methodology now at v4.3.2 (2026-09-19 Elo re-anchoring). AA UI shows "v4.3".
disagreements_with_page.note: Could not confirm that v4.1 also launched in September; the Sep 2 figures are on a pre-v4.2 version. The current string is v4.3 (v4.3.2 in the methodology).

disagreements_with_page.page: at default medium effort beats GPT-6 Astra at max effort on GDPval-AA v2.1 and FrontierCode for about a fifth of the cost per task (Anthropic claim)

agreements_with_page: MiMo-V2.6-Pro 46 on the rescaled index: agrees (46.3 on v4.3), and it is the top open-weights model on AA (next: GLM-5.3 max 44.8).
GPT-6 Sol at maximum effort 48: agrees (47.6 on v4.3). GPT-6 Sol has since been replaced by GPT-6.1 Sol (51.8).

All per-token prices the page states agree with first-party pricing pages and AA: Opus 5.5 $4/$20/$0.20, Opus 5 $5/$25/$0.50, Sonnet 5.5 $2/$10/$0.20, Fable 5.1 $10/$50/$0.25, GPT-6 Astra $10/$50/$1, GPT-6 Sol $2/$10, GPT-6.1 Sol $2/$10/$0.10, GPT-6 Luna $0.10/$0.50, Gemini 3.8 Flash $0.75/$3.75, Gemini 4 Argon $2/$10 introductory then $4/$20, Grok 4.7 $2/$6, Muse Spark 1.3 $1.25/$4.25/$0.15, GLM-5.3-Flash $0.15/$0.50, MiMo-V2.6-Pro $0.435/$0.0036/$0.87, MiMo-V2.6-Flash $0.14/$0.0028/$0.28, DeepSeek V4.1-Flash $0.30/$1.20/$0.006 peak, Step 5 Preview $1.00/$0.05/$2.70.
Kimi K3 output price: the chart_data derived about $15; Kimi lists exactly $15 output ($3 input, $0.30 cache hit), so the derivation is now sourced.
notes: 42 rows have a non-estimated v4.3 index plus a per-token price; 39 of those use the model creator's first-party price.
Values were read from the JSON embedded in artificialanalysis.ai/leaderboards/models and each /models/<slug> page on 2026-10-01; rounding of AA display values is to 0.1 index points.
AA now labels the cost metric "Cost per Task" (per Intelligence Index task); the total "cost to run the Intelligence Index" is still in the page data and is given as cost_to_run_index.

First-party pricing pages checked: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini API, xAI, DeepSeek, Kimi, Z.ai, Alibaba Model Studio. Meta, Mistral, MiniMax, Xiaomi and StepFun prices are as AA lists them "based on" each creator's API; Mistral and MiniMax pricing pages did not expose token prices to the fetcher. StepFun and Xiaomi prices also match third-party reports of their platforms.
gpt-oss-120b, Muse Glimmer and Hy3 have no first-party price on AA; their prices are AA medians across third-party providers and are labelled as such in price_basis.
Gemma 4 31B shows $0 on AA (left null). OLMo 3.1 32B Think has only an estimated index and no price. K2 Horizon 375B has an index (30.5) but no price on AA.

Qwen3.8-Max-0902 appears on AA as "Qwen3.8 Max (0902)". Not found on AA: Tencent Hy4 preview, MiniMax M3.1-Flash-Preview, Naive-N0.5-Flash, Atria Dawn Preview, Sakana Fugu Max/Ultra, TypeSafe Jev, Bonsai 2 27B, Muse Spark 1.3 max pricing announcement, Claude Mythos 5.1, Gemini Deep Think current version, Phi-4 non-estimated score, Command A non-estimated score, Amazon Nova 2 non-estimated score.
Cohere Command A+ has a v4.3 index of 13.1 but AA lists $0 price; Command A (the model the page names) has only an estimated index; neither is included as a priced row.

Effort settings: AA benchmarks several efforts per model; rows include each lab's top effort and, for Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Muse Spark 1.3, a second effort the page discusses. For a one-point-per-model chart use the rows with the highest effort per model.
Muse Spark 1.3 (max) is limited preview; its AA cost uses the Meta API price AA lists.
